name: Permanent Residence by 21+ Months of Temporary Residence

requirements.blocker_text: At least 21 continuous months documented under a temporary residence visa. The application must be submitted before the current temporary visa expires.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 21 continuous months of temporary residence and apply before that visa expires.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate lawful means of subsistence per Ministerial Agreement No. 70 (28 June 2024).
Apostilled/legalized criminal background certificate required for applicants 18 and older.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 21 continuous months of temporary residence
Proof of lawful means of subsistence

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Permanent residence by 21+ months of continuous temporary residence: application-before-expiry timing rule, criminal record and lawful-means-of-subsistence requirements, e-VISAS platform, USD 225 + USD 50 fees, indefinite validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). This is Ecuador's general conversion route from any qualifying temporary residence visa (work, rentista, digital nomad, investor, student) to permanent residence -- see those files' pr_after_months (21) figures, which all point here. citizenship_after_months (15) reflects the remaining time needed to reach ec_naturalisation.json's 3-year (36-month) total residence bar, assuming the full 21 months already accrued as temporary residence counts toward that clock (not independently confirmed whether temporary-residence time counts toward the naturalisation clock the same as permanent-residence time -- treated as a reasonable approximation, not a verified stacking rule).
